thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=hosted-inference-prod, severity=high, incident=PD-81234, trigger=5xx-rate spike on /v1/generate.
ryan-oncall: saw it. I'll ack and start digging.
incident-bot: incident PD-81234 acknowledged by ryan-oncall at 1795054340. Escalation timer reset.
ryan-oncall: quick status: error rate jumped from ~0.3% to 7.2% around 21:05 UTC. Logs show repeated 502s from inference-runtime-3.
maya-sre: pinging infra — I'm on call rotation overlap, can help with infra dig if needed.
samir-eng: I can also look at recent deploys, but nothing scheduled for today.
ryan-oncall: checking node metrics and recent kernel/driver logs. attaching a quick grep: ```grep -i "error.*kvcache" /var/log/inference/runtime.log | tail -n 50``` lots of KV cache eviction + OOM-warning entries.
emily-support: support queue getting ~15% increase in error tickets for chat responses timing out; customers reporting timeouts. tagging support-SRE.
ryan-oncall: attempting restart of inference-runtime-3 pod to see if it recovers (kubectl rollout restart).
incident-bot: automation: restart job submitted for inference-runtime-3 -> job ID restart-1795054390.
ryan-oncall: restart seemed to help briefly but errors resumed after ~30s. suspicion: prefix KV cache corruption leading to constant fallback thrash.
maya-sre: scaling: bumping replica count for the inference pool from 6 -> 9 to absorb traffic while we investigate. issuing: `kubectl scale deployment inference-pool --replicas=9`.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary on-call (lena-manager) paged at 1795054445 (no ack). escalation policy: secondary -> manager.
ryan-oncall: secondary didn't ack, PD shows mobile DND for lena-manager. PD attempted SMS, no response. will try to escalate to manager bridge.
incident-bot: manager bridge page attempted -> broadcast to #incidents-manager-call.
lena-manager: just woke up, joining. on my way to the bridge. :coffee: sorry missed the page, DND on.
ryan-oncall: quick mitigation idea: route a subset of traffic to model-quantized variant (less memory, fewer KV cache dependencies) as a temporary fallback. can someone approve the canary route?
samir-eng: approve canary route. I'll validate the compatibility matrix and open the temporary routing change.
maya-sre: applied routing rule: 20% traffic -> model-x-q2 (quantized); 80% to primary. watching.
incident-bot: telemetry: 5xx rate dropped from 7.2% -> 1.4% after canary routing and scale-up.
emily-support: customer impact note: now at ~1.4% errors, several long-running batch customers still affected, will send interim update: "Degraded API responses observed; mitigation in progress; fallback routing applied."
ryan-oncall: plan: 1) keep canary route, 2) collect heap/profile from runtime pod (verbose gc/alloc traces), 3) embargo further restarts, they bounce state.
lena-manager: if we need an emergency migration off KV cache, authorize it. but want to avoid data loss; samir, confirm if quantized variant returns parity on outputs (smaller differences ok).
samir-eng: quantized returns within acceptable thresholds for our top-10 eval set. approved for temporary routing.
maya-sre: collecting heapdumps now: `gcore` run on inference-runtime-{1,2,4} and saving to s3://redwood-dumps/incidents/1795054321/.
incident-bot: PD note: escalation chain closed by lena-manager (ack) at 1795054472.
ryan-oncall: observed a particular GC thrash loop in runtime logs pointing to allocator churn around the KV cache. suspect leak in the new async-evict path. I'll open a hotfix branch and start bisecting.
lena-manager: good. meantime, please prepare communication for affected customers: severity=degraded-service. emily, can you draft?
emily-support: draft posted in #support-updates, short blurb + link to status page. will include ETA: monitoring for stabilization over next 30 minutes.
ryan-oncall: follow-up actions tracked: - revert async-evict (if hotfix validated) - add circuit-breaker to KV cache path - add traffic-slope guard for future mem thrash. logging created: INC-179505 (owner: ryan-oncall).
maya-sre: metrics to monitor: 5xx rate, p99 latency, pod memory RSS, KV cache eviction rate. created dashboard temp: /dashboards/INC-179505.
incident-bot: incident PD-81234 transitioned to 'under investigation' -> 'mitigated' flagged at 1795054888 after 30 mins of stable metrics.
ryan-oncall: confirming: will keep canary routing for 2 hours then progressively move back if stable. will capture full post-incident writeup. thanks all. :tada:
lena-manager: thanks team — great coordination. agenda item for retro: PD escalation timing and DND overrides for managers.
emily-support: sending customer update now.
incident-bot: thread closed for new automated updates. manual follow-ups ok.
